  • 500 grams of Self Rising Flour (which is flour you can make if you have baking powder and salt - I Cup Flour, 1.5 Tsp Baking Powder, .5 tsp salt - I made 4 cups worth)

  • 2 TSP Dry Yeast

  • 5 TBSP Sugar

  • 250 grams Butter (I cup)

  • 3 Egg YOLKS (save the whites for tomorrow)

  • 1 Cup Sour Cream

This is just for the dough, in which you can either use a processor to beat the nigger out of it or a stand mixer. I used the mixer as I keep to what I know! ---> You want to "process/mix/knead" the butter, egg yolks and sour cream. THEN add the flour, dry yeast, and sugar. IF THE DOUGH IS TOO DRY - add some milk. Of course, if it's TOO WET add some flour.

I left the dough in the mixer's bowl. Let stand overnight in the fridge!

NEXT DAY: Take the dough out before you intend on baking at least 1 to 2 hours before.

I used a pyrex baking dish 9x13 size. Split the dough EQUALLY in half and keep them bastards segregated. ROLL ONE OUT to the shape of your baking dish.
